title: The MafG/Bach1-Lcn2 transcriptional axis drives ferroptosis in sepsis-induced acute lung injury via disrupting redox homeostasis.
authors: Bu, Yue; Li, Zhixi; Wang, Cheng; Yu, Yongjing; Sun, Zhenyu; Zhang, Jinfeng; Han, Lei; Sun, Yue; Gong, Weidong; Luo, Juan; Yue, Ziyong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MafG/Bach1-Lcn2转录轴在脓毒症肺损伤中调控铁死亡，虽涉及转录因子-DNA结合，但以湿实验和表型为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，仅分子对接为辅助，与课题核心方法匹配度低。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVE: Sepsis-induced acute lung injury (SALI) is a life-threatening condition with high mortality, intimately linked to the disruption of intracellular redox homeostasis. Ferroptosis, an iron-dependent form of regulated cell death driven by lipid peroxidation, has been implicated in sepsis-related organ dysfunction. However, its upstream transcriptional regulators, particularly within alveolar epithelial cells, remain poorly defined. This study aims to investigate the role of the transcription factor MafG and its novel interaction with Bach1 in driving ferroptosis during SALI. METHODS: A murine model of sepsis was established via cecal ligation and puncture (CLP). For in vitro studies, MLE-12 cells were treated with conditioned media from LPS-stimulated macrophages. Gene expression was modulated using siRNA and adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated knockdown. Molecular interactions were assessed by co-immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry. Transcriptional regulation was evaluated by luciferase reporter assays. Redox and ferroptosis markers, including lipid ROS, MDA, GSH, Gpx4, and Slc7a11, were measured. The therapeutic potential of Anemoside B4 (AB4) was investigated through molecular docking, surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assays, and in vivo administration. RESULTS: MafG was significantly upregulated in the lungs of septic mice and in CM stimulated alveolar epithelial cells. MafG overexpression exacerbated ferroptosis, while its knockdown conferred protection. Mechanistically, MafG formed a functional heterodimer with Bach1, which directly engages the Lcn2 promoter and drives its transcriptional activation. Lcn2 upregulation drove iron accumulation and lipid peroxidation, culminating in ferroptosis. Overexpression of Lcn2 reversed the anti-ferroptotic effects caused by MafG silencing. In vivo, AAV-shMafG treatment mitigated lung injury, improved redox balance (evidenced by decreased MDA and GSSG, and increased GSH levels), and enhanced survival. Furthermore, we identified AB4 as a potential MafG inhibitor and demonstrated its protective efficacy in vivo. CONCLUSION: The MafG/Bach1-Lcn2 axis represents a novel transcriptional pathway that promotes ferroptosis in SALI by exacerbating oxidative damage. This signaling axis is a promising therapeutic target, and AB4 shows potential as a lead compound for intervention.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：脓毒症诱导的急性肺损伤（SALI）是一种高死亡率的危及生命疾病，与细胞内氧化还原稳态的破坏密切相关。铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种由脂质过氧化驱动的铁依赖性调节性细胞死亡形式，已被认为与脓毒症相关器官功能障碍有关。然而，其上游转录调控因子，特别是在肺泡上皮细胞中的调控因子，仍知之甚少。本研究旨在探讨转录因子MafG及其与Bach1的新型相互作用在SALI期间驱动铁死亡中的作用。方法：通过盲肠结扎穿刺（CLP）建立小鼠脓毒症模型。体外研究中，用脂多糖（LPS）刺激的巨噬细胞条件培养基处理MLE-12细胞。使用siRNA和腺相关病毒（AAV）介导的敲低调节基因表达。通过免疫共沉淀和质谱法评估分子相互作用。通过荧光素酶报告基因实验评估转录调控。测量氧化还原和铁死亡标志物，包括脂质ROS、MDA、GSH、Gpx4和Slc7a11。通过分子对接、表面等离子体共振（SPR）实验和体内给药研究白头翁皂苷B4（AB4）的治疗潜力。结果：MafG在脓毒症小鼠肺部和条件培养基刺激的肺泡上皮细胞中显著上调。MafG过表达加剧铁死亡，而其敲低则提供保护。机制上，MafG与Bach1形成功能性异二聚体，直接结合Lcn2启动子并驱动其转录激活。Lcn2上调导致铁积累和脂质过氧化，最终引发铁死亡。Lcn2过表达逆转了MafG沉默引起的抗铁死亡效应。体内实验中，AAV-shMafG治疗减轻了肺损伤，改善了氧化还原平衡（表现为MDA和GSSG降低，GSH水平升高），并提高了生存率。此外，我们鉴定AB4为潜在的MafG抑制剂，并证明了其在体内的保护功效。结论：MafG/Bach1-Lcn2轴代表了一条新的转录通路，通过加剧氧化损伤促进SALI中的铁死亡。该信号轴是一个有前景的治疗靶点，AB4显示出作为干预先导化合物的潜力。
